decisions.reason: After two years this camera still fits the core portfolio and likely costs little to maintain, but the extra year without stronger positive signals modestly raises withdrawal risk.
The modular multi-model line remains a flexible option across different missions, so its strategic option value is high and abandonment pressure stays low.

This sensor suite is more exploratory than the standard camera products, so with demand still uncertain it is worth keeping, though the chance of withdrawal is somewhat higher as information accumulates.
As a newly launched radiation-hard camera family close to the firm's core capabilities, it is too early to abandon and the product-line format supports keeping the option open.

The asteroid navigation and imaging camera is the most niche current option, but because it is still new and technologically adjacent to the core business, management would keep it for now while watching mission demand.
